author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inline fuel filter mirrored about x=24 on VRECT_L: the upper pipe rises into the raised cap; the lower pipe runs into the bowl, whose top is three hanging scallops (the fuel line), with straight sides, a V bottom and a drip below. No Lucide match; straight and cardinal-arc construction.
omissions: The teardrop is drawn as a short drip stroke; a teardrop outline with a valid hole needs about 11 units of height below the bowl. The cap has square centerline corners.
